$comment: Curation layer for the Google Drive library (src/data/library.generated.json).
The generated index says what a file IS (type, size, folder path). This file
says what it is FOR: which shelf it belongs on and which subjects it covers.
shelves:  research | report | ebook | guide | training | other
'research' and 'report' are read-only work; 'ebook' is study material.
subjects: short chips shown on cards and used as filters. Keep them few and
stable — pesticide, fertilizer, soil, gap, plantation, nursery,
krishak-card, policy, ai, training, finance, self-learning.
'byPath' matches the top-level Drive folder (case-insensitive) and applies to
every file inside it that has no explicit entry in 'entries'. 'default' applies
to everything else. An entry key is the file id from the generated index.
Nothing here changes any count, and nothing here can break the build.
